Chronology of every recorded fact about [[gatestone]], in reading order. Generated from the same verified fact store as the main article.

== Ghostwater ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|'''Ch 15''' — Yan Shoumei crushed a gatestone to vanish.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|'''Ch 16''' — Crushing a gatestone allows for instant return to a specific place.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|'''Ch 16''' — Gatestones are used by others to escape Ghostwater.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|'''Ch 16''' — Lindon uses a gatestone that looks like a chalky ball of crushed blue glass.}}

== Underlord ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|'''Ch 11''' — A gatestone is a blue stone that allows for vanishing in a flash of blue.}}

== Wintersteel ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|'''Ch 13''' — Gatestones are devices used for spatial transport that are supplied by the Akura clan for contribution points.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|'''Ch 14''' — A gatestone can be used to transport individuals back to the Abyssal Palace.}}

== Dreadgod ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|'''Ch 3''' — Pride used a blue gatestone to vanish.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|'''Ch 7''' — Gatestones can be used to stress a spatial lock field.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|'''Ch 11''' — A gatestone can be crushed into sapphire powder.}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|'''Ch 14''' — Yerin possesses a gatestone.}}
